name: reset_boot
summary: RESET and BOOT tactile switches for an ESP32-S3 module: RESET pulls EN low (with Espressif's 0.1 uF), BOOT pulls IO0 low; IO0 has the pull-up Espressif recommends.

sources.document: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & WROOM-1U Datasheet, figure 9-1 Peripheral Schematics: SW1 from EN to GND with C8 0.1 uF; boot option on IO0 to GND
ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & WROOM-1U Datasheet, table 6-2 Recommended Operating Conditions (VDD33 3.0-3.6 V)
Espressif ESP32-S3 Hardware Design Guidelines, section 1.3.9 Strapping Pins: a pull-up resistor at GPIO0 is recommended; no high-value capacitors at GPIO0
Ohm's law: the GPIO0 pull-up draws at most 3.6 V / 10 kohm = 360 uA, while BOOT is pressed
Copper design choice: 10 kohm for the GPIO0 pull-up (Espressif recommends a pull-up but gives no value)
sources.standard: Copper design choice (2026-11-21), not a datasheet value

notes.text: RESET: switch from EN to GND with 0.1 uF, as in Espressif's figure (its 0 ohm R7 is omitted). BOOT: hold BOOT, press and release RESET to enter download mode.
GPIO0 has a pull-up as Espressif recommends; no capacitor is placed on GPIO0, which could force download mode.
The 10 kohm value of the GPIO0 pull-up is Copper's choice: Espressif gives no value.
